Farmers cut terraces into the hill to grow rice.

easy.def: The shape and type of the land.
examples: The terrain is rocky.
We crossed rough terrain.
The terrain is flat.

more.def: The kind of land you find in a place, such as rocky, hilly or flat ground.
examples: The rocky terrain made it hard for the truck to drive.
We hiked over hilly terrain all day.
The rover rolled over the rough terrain of Mars.

easy.def: Very bad.
examples: I had a terrible dream.
The milk smells terrible.
I have a terrible cold.

more.def: Very bad or unpleasant.
examples: A terrible storm knocked out the power for two days.
The roads were in terrible shape after the flood.
He felt terrible about forgetting her birthday.

easy.def: Very badly, or very much.
examples: I am terribly sorry.
The car shook terribly.
She was terribly tired.

more.def: In a very bad way, or to a very great degree.
examples: I am terribly sorry I broke it.
The old bus shook terribly.
She was terribly tired after the long hike.

easy.def: A small, lively dog.
examples: The terrier barked.
My terrier is small.
A terrier chased a ball.

more.def: A small, lively dog that was first bred to hunt small animals.
examples: The terrier barked at the mail carrier.
A terrier dug a hole in the garden.
Our little terrier chases balls all day.

easy.def: Very good.
examples: We had a terrific time.
The cake was terrific.
What a terrific idea!

more.def: Extremely good.
examples: We had a terrific time at the fair.
The soup was terrific.
She came up with a terrific idea.

easy.def: Very, very scared.
examples: The kitten was terrified.
I was terrified of the dark.
She was terrified of thunder.

more.def: Extremely frightened.
examples: The kitten was terrified by the loud noise.
He was terrified of the big dog.
The little girl felt terrified during the storm.

easy.def: To scare very much.
examples: Thunder may terrify the dog.
The noise terrified me.
The movie terrified him.

more.def: To make someone very afraid.
examples: The loud thunder terrified the puppy.
The scary mask terrified the little boy.
Heights terrify me.

easy.def: Very scary.
examples: The storm was terrifying.
A terrifying roar came from the cave.
The thunder was terrifying.

more.def: Causing great fear.
examples: The terrifying thunder made the puppy hide under the bed.
A terrifying roar echoed from the cave.
The roller coaster looked terrifying from the ground.

easy.def: In a very scary way.
examples: The wind howled terrifyingly.
The dog barked terrifyingly.
It was terrifyingly dark.

more.def: In a way that is very frightening.
examples: The ride was terrifyingly fast.
The wolf howled terrifyingly in the night.
The cliff was terrifyingly high.

easy.def: Guarding your own place and not letting others in.
examples: The dog is territorial.
Birds are territorial.
A territorial cat.

more.def: Defending your own area and trying to keep others out of it, as many animals do.
examples: The dog is territorial and barks at anyone near the gate.
Robins are territorial birds that chase others from their nest area.
The cat was territorial about its favorite chair.

easy.def: Land that belongs to a person, animal or country.
examples: The lion guards its territory.
The territory is large.
The bird defends its territory.

more.def: An area of land that belongs to one person, animal or country.
examples: The lion protected its territory.
The explorers entered new territory.
Each wolf pack has its own territory.

easy.def: Very great fear.
examples: The child screamed in terror.
She felt terror.
The terror passed.

more.def: A feeling of very great fear.
examples: The child screamed in terror at the thunder.
She froze in terror when she saw the snake.
The terror faded when the lights came on.

easy.def: Questions that show what you know.
examples: We have a spelling test.
I got every answer right on the test.
The math test was easy.

more.def: A set of questions or tasks that shows how much you know or can do.
examples: I studied hard for my science test.
The vision test at school was easy.
Each student took a spelling test on Friday.

easy.def: To try something to see how it works.
examples: We test the boat in the tub.
She tested the water with her toe.
Dad tests the smoke alarm.

more.def: To try something out to find out how well it works or what it is.
examples: Scientists tested the new robot in the lab.
She tested the water with her toe before jumping in.
We tested which paper towel soaks up the most water.

easy.def: Something that proves that something is true.
examples: The medal is a testament to her hard work.
The old bridge is a testament.
The tall tower is a testament.

more.def: Something that shows or proves that something is true or good.
examples: The shiny medal is a testament to her hard work.
The old stone bridge is a testament to the skill of its builders.
Her kind letters are a testament to her caring heart.

easy.def: A person or sample used to try something out.
examples: A tester tried the game.
The tester sprayed the perfume.
He is a game tester.

more.def: A person who tries something out, or a sample you can try.
examples: A game tester tried the new toy.
The store had a tester of the paint color.
He is a tester at the factory.

easy.def: To tell what you know in a court of law.
examples: The man will testify in court.
She testified at the trial.
He testified that he saw it.

more.def: To say what you saw or know in a court, as a witness.
examples: The witness testified about what she saw.
He testified that he heard a loud noise.
The girl was asked to testify in court.

easy.def: What someone says in court.
examples: The witness gave her testimony.
His testimony was clear.
The judge listened to her testimony.

more.def: A statement that a person says in a court of law after promising to tell the truth.
examples: The witness gave her testimony in court.
His testimony helped the judge decide.
Her testimony was calm and clear.

easy.def: Cranky and easily upset.
examples: He was testy today.
The testy man snapped.
She was testy and tired.

more.def: Impatient and easily annoyed.
examples: He was testy because he was tired.
The testy man snapped at the waiter.
She felt testy after the long wait.

easy.def: A rope that keeps an animal in place.
examples: The horse has a tether.
A tether holds the goat.
The tether is long.

more.def: A rope or chain that ties an animal or object so it cannot wander far.
examples: The goat is on a tether in the yard.
A long tether held the balloon.
The tether let the horse graze nearby.

easy.def: To tie with a rope.
examples: Tether the horse.
She tethered the goat.
He tethered the boat.

more.def: To tie an animal or thing with a rope so it cannot move far.
examples: She tethered the goat to a post.
He tethered the boat to the dock.
The camper tethered the tent to the ground.

easy.def: The words in a book or on a page.
examples: Read the text.
The text is small.
The text is on the screen.

more.def: The written words in a book, on a page or on a screen.
examples: Read the text of the story aloud.
The text on the sign was tiny.
The book has more pictures than text.

easy.def: A short message on a phone.
examples: I got a text from Mom.
Send a text.
The text said "Hello."

more.def: A short written message that you send on a phone.
examples: I sent a text to my dad.
The text said that she would be late.
I got a text from my friend.

easy.def: A book you use to learn at school.
examples: Open your textbook.
The math textbook is heavy.
I read my science textbook.

more.def: A book that students use to learn about a subject, with lessons and questions inside.
examples: Open your science textbook to the chapter about plants.
Her math textbook has practice problems at the end of every lesson.
Our history textbook has maps and pictures of old castles.

easy.def: Cloth or fabric.
examples: Cotton is a textile.
The textile is soft.
Wool is a textile.

more.def: A cloth or fabric that is woven or knitted.
examples: Cotton and wool are common textiles.
The textile mill made blankets.
The museum has old textiles from many lands.

easy.def: How something feels when you touch it.
examples: The rock has a rough texture.
Silk has a smooth texture.
I like the texture.

more.def: The way the surface of something feels when you touch it, such as rough, smooth or soft.
examples: The kitten's fur has a soft texture.
Sandpaper has a rough texture.
The pudding had a smooth, creamy texture.
